facts.fact: KRAY 与 Tad I. PI 按时抵达九龙半岛酒店大堂，进行两人的 BE（Brief Encounter）接头。
facts.anchor: KRAY and Tad I. PI both arrive on time for their BE, or Brief Encounter, meeting in the lobby of the Peninsula Hotel in Kowloon, Hong Kong.

facts.fact: 两人以“作用力与反作用力”和“对回声的解释”对暗号。
facts.anchor: “For every action there’s an equal and opposite reaction,” to which KRAY replies, “Which would be the explanation of an echo.”

facts.fact: 两人按计划会合，乘渡轮前往香港岛，途中敲定掩护说法。
facts.anchor: They meet as planned and ride the ferry over to Hong Kong Island, nailing down their cover story on the way.

facts.fact: PI 告知 KRAY：Wacker 在电话中要求 PI 汇报 KRAY 可能提出的任何异常问题。
facts.anchor: Wacker had asked PI to report back any unusual questions KRAY might ask.

facts.fact: PI 申请在港再任两年，但七楼有人从中阻挠。
facts.anchor: “I’ve put in for two more years here, but somebody on the Seventh Floor is fighting it.

facts.fact: 两人打车到赤柱海滩，进入赤柱大街 90 号、正对赤柱湾的 Pickled Pelican 酒吧。
facts.anchor: They take a cab over to Stanley Beach, where they go to the Pickled Pelican at 90 Stanley Main Street, right across the road from Stanley Bay.

facts.fact: PI 用左脚勾住英国人吧凳的一条腿，把他连人带凳掀翻。
facts.anchor: PI hooks his left foot around one of the legs of the Brit’s bar stool.

facts.fact: 次日报纸称 Pickled Pelican 的袭击者是两名来度假的、毫无特色的喧闹加拿大人。
facts.anchor: The next day’s papers report that the Pickled Pelican assailants had been a nondescript pair of rowdy Canadians on holiday.
